about: Once Upon a Diner is the story expansion to Diner Dash: Hometown Hero, released in 2009 as its own titled product. Grandma Florence buys a magic lamp and rushes to Flo's diner with the tale, and the campaign follows her into a fairy-tale theme - storybook venues, fantasy regulars and the same seat-them, serve-them, chain-them loop the hometown engine is built on.

It sat on the shelf next to the seasonal snack pack as Hometown Hero's second expansion line, and the release databases carry it as a distinct product: igdb and kotaku both list it under its own title, and wikipedia's hometown hero entry names it among the game's expansions. The dinertown universe thus got its storybook wing the same year avenue flo took flo point-and-click.

Like every portal-era playfirst product that missed the steam cut, the expansion lost its store when the portals closed. No standalone archive route has surfaced yet, so this page's download section says so honestly - the base game it rides on is the part that survived, archived and still selling.
